name: onnxruntime-c
description: Same as the official onnxruntime-c 1.28.0 pod, but taken from Microsoft's NuGet package (Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime 1.28.0, checked by SHA-256) because download.onnxruntime.ai stopped serving a valid certificate in November 2026.
prepare_command: unzip -q runtimes/ios/native/onnxruntime.xcframework.zip -d . && mkdir -p Headers && cp build/native/include/* Headers/ && cp onnxruntime.xcframework/ios-arm64/onnxruntime.framework/Headers/*.h Headers/
